headline: Brazil Simplifies Cosmetics Exports to Latin American Markets
summary: The Brazilian government issued a decree incorporating an ALADI agreement that removes technical trade barriers for cosmetics, perfumes, and personal hygiene products exported to other Latin American nations.
why: Reducing regulatory friction for exports can improve profit margins and market access for Brazil's significant cosmetics manufacturing sector.

impacts.name: Cosmetics
impacts.why: Lower trade barriers reduce costs and simplify logistics for Brazilian exporters in the region.
